findings.finding: strip_prefix("## ") also matches lines starting with "### " because "### " starts with "## ". This causes h3 sub-headers to be incorrectly parsed as h2 section boundaries during initial parsing.
findings.fix: Changed to explicit starts_with check: line.starts_with("## ") && !line.starts_with("### "). Added regression test parse_does_not_confuse_h3_for_h2.

findings.finding: artifact_zip_path uses std::sync::Mutex<Option<PathBuf>>. This is consistent with the existing store Mutex pattern in the codebase.

summary: Code is well-structured. Major bug found and fixed: h2/h3 header confusion in parser. All 13 unit tests pass. Clippy clean. Error handling uses anyhow::Context consistently. Idempotency check works correctly.
